name: 색상 히스토그램 시프트 분석
description: Detects face vs background color histogram shift
algorithm: Color Histogram Shift — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method detects temporal color histogram shifts for video deepfake detection following Zheng et al. (2021):

1. **Per-Frame색상히스토그램계산**: For each frame, color histograms are computed in multiple color spaces (RGB, HSV, Lab) across face and background regions separately. Histograms capture the overall color distribution with bin resolution tuned to detect subtle shifts.

2. **Inter-Frame히스토그램비교**: Consecutive frame histograms are compared using Earth Mover's Distance (EMD), chi-squared distance, and Bhattacharyya distance. Natural video shows smooth, gradual histogram evolution. Deepfakes may produce frame-to-frame color distribution jumps, especially when the face generator's color model differs from the source video.

3. **얼굴-Background색상일관성**: The color histogram relationship between face regions and background is analyzed per frame. In authentic video, face and background share the same white balance and color grading. Deepfake face insertion may introduce subtle color distribution mismatches — the generated face may have different color temperature or saturation characteristics than the background.

4. **시간적색상안정성분석**: Long-term color histogram trends are tracked. Natural illumination changes produce smooth, physically motivated color shifts (gradual, affecting all regions similarly). Deepfakes may produce oscillating or jerky color histogram changes as the generator struggles to maintain consistent color rendering across frames.

5. **히스토그램이상점수 산출**: Statistical tests detect frames with significant color histogram deviations from temporal neighbors. The score combines inter-frame stability, face-background coherence, and long-term trend analysis, quantifying the likelihood of color manipulation or AI generation artifacts.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through color histogram shift analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
